agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-agents-md.description: Audit an AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rule or Copilot instructions file for stale commands, broken paths, vague rules, secrets and contradictions. Use to review or trim agent instructions.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-agents-md.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-brag-doc-.description: Build an evidence-based brag doc or self-review draft from your merged PRs and commits, leaving visible gaps where results are unknown. Use for review season, promotion cases or resumes.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-brag-doc-.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-dependenc.description: Upgrade one dependency at a time by reading its changelog, planning for breaking changes, updating code and proving it still builds and passes. Use to bump, update or migrate a package.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-dependenc.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-explain-c.description: Map an unfamiliar repo covering purpose, entry points, how to run it, main modules, data flow and risky areas, with file references. Use when asked to explain or onboard onto a codebase.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-explain-c.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-pr-descri.description: Write a pull request title and description from the actual diff and commits, with what changed, why, how it was tested and what to review. Use when asked to write or improve a PR description.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-pr-descri.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-prove-it-.description: Verify that tests, builds and checks actually ran and exercised the changed code, before claiming a task is done. Use before reporting completion, or when asked to prove tests ran or verify a fix.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-prove-it-.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-repro-fir.description: Debug by reproducing the failure first, then forming and testing hypotheses before editing code. Use when asked to fix a bug, a failing test, a crash or unexpected behavior.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-repro-fir.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-review-my.description: Self-review uncommitted or branch changes before a PR, with findings ranked by severity and backed by file and line evidence. Use when asked to review my changes or check my diff.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-review-my.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-safe-refa.description: Refactor in small, verified steps, with behavior locked by tests before any change. Use when asked to refactor, clean up, rename, extract or restructure code without changing behavior.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-safe-refa.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-security-.description: Quick security pass over a change covering secrets, injection, auth and access checks, unsafe deserialization, dependency and config risks, with evidence. Use before merging input or auth code.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-security-.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-session-h.description: Write a HANDOFF.md that lets a fresh agent session continue the work, with goal, state, decisions, next steps and traps. Use when ending a long session, hitting context limits or switching agents.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-session-h.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-write-age.description: Draft a short, accurate AGENTS.md (and a CLAUDE.md bridge) for a repository from evidence in the repo. Use when a project has no agent instructions, or when asked to create or rewrite AGENTS.md.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-write-age.author: AgentKit Co

agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-write-sub.description: Draft a Claude Code subagent file in .claude/agents/ for one repeatable job, with a trigger-ready description, minimal tools and a fitting model. Use to create, fix or tune a subagent.
agentkitco-agentkit-dev-skills-write-sub.author: AgentKit Co
